name: private-bookmark
description: Private bookmarks and visit history stored locally in Chrome using SQLite WASM.

scripts.start: npm run copy:static && parcel watch src/pages/popup/popup.html src/pages/add/add.html src/pages/view/view.html src/pages/options/options.html src/pages/history/history.html src/pages/sql/sql.html src/background.js --no-cache --no-hmr --dist-dir dist
scripts.build: npm run clean && parcel build src/pages/popup/popup.html src/pages/add/add.html src/pages/view/view.html src/pages/options/options.html src/pages/history/history.html src/pages/sql/sql.html src/background.js --no-cache --dist-dir dist --no-source-maps && npm run copy:static
